Attached: 1 image

There's a number that decides whether a voice agent feels magical or broken: about 800 milliseconds.
That's the pause a caller tolerates before a conversation starts feeling like a bad overseas call.
The budget: ~200ms to hear (speech-to-text), ~400ms to think (the model), ~200ms to speak (text-to-speech).
The part teams miss: the model usually isn't the slow part. The plumbing is. Every extra hop spends budget the model needed for a good answer.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
